desc:
ALL ITEMS SAVE IN SOLO GAMES EVEN ON THE FLOOR!

👍 THUMBS UP for more UPDATES and a FREE CODE at 1,000 LIKES 👍

🖥️ PC Controls:

E or Click - Pickup / Place Item
G - Drop Item
Q - Unlock Mouse

🎮 Controller Controls:

RT/R2 - Pickup / Place Item
LT/L2 - Drop Item
Upgrades - Y/🔺

🧸 Your local restaurant has been turned upside down and the food is everywhere! Unlock your inner collector and help clean up the mess by sorting hundreds of Food, Drinks, & Chairs hidden around the entire interior!

👥 Cleanup alone or with friends!
🏁 Race for the fastest times on the leaderboard!
🔓 Earn upgrades and abilities to help make the job easier!

✨ Inspired by cute cleanup and collecting games ✨
